paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
1. // oṃ awighnamastu, iti kawruh iṅ usadha wyādhi, wyādhi tiwaṅ, pahit twaṅ nyāḥ, tiwaṅ stuluṅ, tiwaṅ sapulih, tiwaṅ tumbul, tiwaṅ slikit, tiwaṅ
2. kaluṅkuṅ, tiwaṅ prakatos, tiwaṅ kaput, tiwaṅ galuwaṅ, tiwaṅ sembraṅ, tiwaṅ silā, tiwaṅ piṇḍita, tiwaṅ kadi, tiwaṅ sunduk, tiwaṅ puwāka, tiwaṅ
3. bukuṅ, tiwaṅ anut, mwaṅ tiwaṅ tatut, tiwaṅ balos, tiwaṅ jaladri, puha pupuhuṅan hati, patiḥ lumbarikā. // yaṅ tiwaṅ lumbarikā
4. sarwaṅkan tiwaṅ lumbarikā, tiwaṅ jaladri loloh don ... , tiwaṅ balos loloh don [tidak terbaca]
paleography.indonesian_translation:
Semoga tiada rintangan. Inilah pengetahuan tentang pengobatan berbagai penyakit, yakni penyakit tiwang: pahit twang nyah, tiwang stulung, tiwang sapulih, tiwang tumbul, tiwang slikit, tiwang kalungkung, tiwang prakatos, tiwang kaput, tiwang galuwang, tiwang sembrang, tiwang sila, tiwang pindita, tiwang kadi, tiwang sunduk, tiwang puwaka, tiwang bukung, tiwang anut, serta tiwang tatut, tiwang balos, tiwang jaladri, rasa nyeri menusuk pada ulu hati, patih lumbarika. Jika terkena tiwang lumbarika...
segala jenis tiwang lumbarika; untuk tiwang jaladri minum loloh daun [tidak terbaca], untuk tiwang balos minum loloh daun [tidak terbaca].
paleography.english_translation:
May there be no hindrance. This is the knowledge of medical treatments for diseases, namely tiwang ailments: pahit twang nyah, tiwang stulung, tiwang sapulih, tiwang tumbul, tiwang slikit, tiwang kalungkung, tiwang prakatos, tiwang kaput, tiwang galuwang, tiwang sembrang, tiwang sila, tiwang pindita, tiwang kadi, tiwang sunduk, tiwang puwaka, tiwang bukung, tiwang anut, as well as tiwang tatut, tiwang balos, tiwang jaladri, piercing pain in the chest/solar plexus, patih lumbarika. If afflicted with tiwang lumbarika...
all varieties of tiwang lumbarika; for tiwang jaladri, drink a potion (loloh) of leaves of [unreadable], for tiwang balos drink a potion of leaves of [unreadable].

2. paksa ring sapanjangnikā , yayanya ngka rěpat sanghyang tithi , hangling ghana bhima hita , mapanganten hing , bhāwana sanghyang [tidak terbaca] paksi mañjarī , paksi gulu

paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
1. Semoga ada keselamatan. Pada masa lalu kemasyhuran/kebaikan, kiranya keindahannya, itulah yang patut ditanyakan di sana, berbicara secara saksama, di sanalah mereka menyapa, dahulu berkatalah burung bima, angin...
2. bersayap sepanjang waktu itu, tatkala bertepatan dengan sang hyang tithi (waktu/penanggalan suci), bersabdalah awan pelindung/bima yang bajik, bersatu pada alam sang hyang ... burung manjari, burung tekukur/burung berleher...
3. beraneka ragam, puncaknya bersatu pada sang hyang, kepada sang raja telah paripurna sang hyang tamri, burung tua menyambut. Demikianlah perinciannya...
4. pada Sang Hyang Ramawijaya serta Sang Hyang Tri, kepada para hyang lambang... tampaklah Sang Hyang Pralapakara (pembuat ungkapan/puisi), siapakah beliau, yang berkedudukan dalam jalannya lambang puisi.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
1. Hail, may there be well-being. In the past, the renown and beauty, that is what should be asked there, carefully speaking, there they greeted, earlier spoke the bird of Bhima, the wind...
2. winged throughout that span, at that moment meeting the sacred lunar day (sang hyang tithi), spoke the benevolent cloud/protective cloud, joined in the realm of the deities ... manjari bird, the necked bird...
3. diverse, the pinnacle uniting in the divine presence, to the king is completed the sacred copper/tamri, the elder bird receives. Such are the details...
4. regarding Sang Hyang Ramawijaya and Sang Hyang Tri, to the divine literary emblems... there appears Sang Hyang Pralapakara, who is he, abiding in the course of poetic verse.

1. // muwah yan ring cangkĕm, sakarong-rong, yan ring prana, mawetu bahu panĕs, tutos,

3. waduk, mawetu basang sakit, tuju karingetan, tutohnya don kaliki,

paleography.indonesian_translation:
Dan jika berada pada mulut, [terasa sakit pada rongga], jika pada nafas, menyebabkan bahu terasa panas, menembus,
tubuhnya, sebab jika berada pada hati, mengeluarkan rasa sakit perut yang parah, menusuk, jika pada
perut bagian bawah/lambung, menyebabkan perut sakit, rematik yang mengeluarkan keringat, obat tetesnya (tutuh) adalah daun jarak (kaliki),
daun sembung, kapur bubuk, // jika pada paru-paru/hati dalam, / obat perut kembung/sebah, garam
paleography.english_translation:
And if it is in the mouth, painful in both cavities; if in the breath/chest, it causes hot shoulders, piercing through
the body, because if in the liver/heart, it causes severe abdominal pain, sharp pain; if in the
stomach, it causes stomach ache, rheumatic condition with perspiration; its tetes (tutuh) drops are kaliki (castor) leaves,
sembung leaves, powdered lime, // if in the lungs/viscera, / medicine for a bloated stomach, salt

... ya ta matangyan dewa ring ... manggihang waranugraha, ring ...
nging teka ring satru, mwang ring bhuta ... ring satru musuh, dewa ...
tan katon ring satru sira, aywa ... ring satru, mwang ring durjana ...
nguniweh ring wong lyan, mwang ring para ... manggih sukha ri wekas ...

[Lembar 2]
... ngaranira, dewa ring sarira ... sahananing mantra sakti ...
ring satru mwang ring durjana kabeh ... tatan ana mantranira ...
nging ta sira mulaning mantra kabeh ... ring sarira kabeh ...
rinaksa dewa bhatara, manggih dirghayusa ... manggih kasantosaning sarira ...
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Oleh karena itu para dewata menganugerahkan anugerah, kepada ... tetapi hingga pada musuh, serta pada bhuta ... terhadap musuh, dewata ... tidak terlihat oleh musuh beliau, janganlah ... pada musuh, serta pada orang jahat ... terlebih lagi pada orang lain, dan pada para ... menemukan kebahagiaan di kemudian hari ...

[Lembar 2]
... namanya, dewata di dalam badan/diri ... segala mantra sakti ... pada musuh dan pada orang-orang jahat semua ... tidak ada mantranya ... melainkan dialah asal mula segala mantra ... di dalam seluruh badan ... dilindungi oleh para dewa dan bhatara, memperoleh umur panjang ... memperoleh ketenteraman bagi badan/diri ...
paleography.english_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Therefore the deities grant blessings, unto ... even unto enemies, and unto evil spirits ... towards enemies, the deities ... unseen by enemies, do not ... towards enemies, and towards malicious people ... furthermore towards other people, and towards ... finding happiness in the future ...

[Lembar 2]
... his/her name, the deity within the body/self ... all powerful mantras ... against all enemies and evil people ... there is no mantra ... but it is the origin of all mantras ... within the whole body ... protected by gods and deities, attaining long life ... attaining peace for the body/self ...

paleography.indonesian_translation:

... itulah Beliau Bhatara ... keberadaannya di dalam tubuh ...
nama dari tubuh, di sinilah ... pengetahuannya yang bijaksana, pada ...
tamu/kedatangannya, di sanalah memusatkan pikiran ... tata caranya yang dinamakan mengikuti ...
setelah demikian, itulah yang mengetahui ... itulah namanya ...

[Lembar 2]
... itulah yang dinamakan pemikiran/perenungan mendalam, sabda Beliau ... segala yang ada pada tubuh di perhimpunan ...
hendaknya diingat di dalam tubuh ... nama Beliau di dalam tubuh di batin ...
pada raga serta tubuh, terlebih lagi ... tata caranya pada tubuh, itulah ...
Beliau, itulah nama Beliau ... pada tubuh tersebut ...
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
... that is the divine Bhatara ... its presence within the inner body ...
the name of the body, here it is ... wisdom, in ...
its presence, there one focuses the mind ... the procedure called following ...
after that, that is what knows ... that is the name ...

... that is what is called contemplation/deliberation, His words ... all within the body in assembly ...
should be remembered in the body ... His name within the inner body ...
in the physique and the body, moreover ... its manner in the body, that is ...
His, that is His name ... in that body ...
